entities.summary: Mary Elizabeth Magill is an American legal scholar. She served as the 9th president of the University of Pennsylvania from July 2022 to December 2023. Prior to that she was executive vice president and provost of the University of Virginia from 2019 to 2022. Before heading to Virginia, she spent over 7 years as the 13th dean of Stanford Law School from 2012 to 2019. She was announced as the incoming dean of Georgetown University Law Center on August 1, 2026.
